parsed.note_claim: Zohran Mamdani has not been mayor of New York City for fifty days, or any days, and will not take office until January 1, 2026.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The current and 112th mayor is Zohran Mamdani , who was elected on November 4, 2025, and took office shortly after midnight on January 1, 2026.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states Mamdani's term began on January 1, 2026, confirming he was not mayor prior to that date.
